proof:
Source: parent proof of Simon 2.8, Section C5(b) (Simon's (4): ∫|D(φu)| ≤ ∫|Dφ||u| + ∫φ|Du|, applied to one test field g).
Notation: E := Rn n, μ := volume, Dφ := fderiv ℝ φ, K_φ and K_g Lipschitz constants of φ and ⇑g (IsLipschitzTestField g provides K_g).
1. Pointwise bound for g. ⇑g is continuous with compact support, so x ↦ ‖g x‖ is bounded (Continuous.bounded_above_of_compact_support) and its range is bounded above; therefore ‖g x‖ ≤ sSup (range fun x ↦ ‖g x‖) = compactlySupportedSupNorm g ≤ 1 for every x (le_csSup).
2. The field ψ(y) := φ(y)•g(y). (i) ψ is (K_φ + K_g)-Lipschitz: ψ(x) − ψ(y) = (φ(x) − φ(y))•g(x) + φ(y)•(g(x) − g(y)), so ‖ψ(x) − ψ(y)‖ ≤ K_φ‖x − y‖·1 + 1·K_g‖x − y‖ using ‖g‖ ≤ 1 and |φ| ≤ 1. (ii) support ψ ⊆ support φ, so tsupport ψ ⊆ tsupport φ ⊆ U and ψ has compact support (HasCompactSupport.smul_right). (iii) ‖ψ(y)‖ = φ(y)‖g(y)‖ ≤ 1.
3. Admissibility. Submission.bv_ext_ofReal_integral_le_bvVariationOn (v := u, G := ψ, W := U) gives ofReal(∫ x in U, u·div ψ) ≤ bvVariationOn u U. Since div ψ = 0 off tsupport ψ ⊆ U (Chapter02.support_euclideanDivergence_subset), ∫ x in U, u·div ψ = ∫ u·div ψ (setIntegral_eq_integral_of_forall_compl_eq_zero).
4. A.e. product rule. φ and ⇑g are Lipschitz, so both are differentiable at μ-a.e. x (LipschitzWith.ae_differentiableAt, intersect the two a.e. sets). At such x, Submission.bv_ext_euclideanDivergence_smul gives div ψ(x) = φ(x)·div g(x) + Dφ(x)[g(x)].
5. Pointwise a.e. inequality. At such x, φ(x)·u(x)·div g(x) = u(x)·div ψ(x) − u(x)·Dφ(x)[g(x)] ≤ u(x)·div ψ(x) + |u(x)|·‖Dφ(x)‖, because |Dφ(x)[g(x)]| ≤ ‖Dφ(x)‖·‖g(x)‖ ≤ ‖Dφ(x)‖ by step 1.
6. Integrability. φ·u·div g is integrable (φ continuous with |φ| ≤ 1; |div g| ≤ n·K_g by Chapter02.norm_euclideanDivergence_le_of_lipschitz and div g is measurable by Chapter02.measurable_euclideanDivergence; u ∈ L¹); u·div ψ is integrable in the same way (|div ψ| ≤ n(K_φ + K_g)); |u|·‖Dφ‖ is integrable (‖Dφ‖ ≤ K_φ by norm_fderiv_le_of_lipschitz, measurable by measurable_fderiv). No measurability of x ↦ Dφ(x)[g(x)] is needed.
7. Integrating step 5 (integral_mono_ae, integral_add): ∫ φ·u·div g ≤ ∫ u·div ψ + ∫ |u|·‖Dφ‖ = ∫ x in U, u·div ψ + ∫ |u|·‖Dφ‖ (step 3).
8. Passing to [0, ∞] (ENNReal.ofReal_le_ofReal, ENNReal.ofReal_add_le): ofReal(∫ φ·u·div g) ≤ ofReal(∫ x in U, u·div ψ) + ofReal(∫ |u|·‖Dφ‖) ≤ bvVariationOn u U + ∫⁻ ‖u‖ₑ‖Dφ‖ₑ, using step 3 and ofReal(∫|u|‖Dφ‖) = ∫⁻ ofReal(|u|‖Dφ‖) = ∫⁻ ‖u‖ₑ‖Dφ‖ₑ (ofReal_integral_eq_lintegral_ofReal; the integrand is nonnegative and integrable). (The hypothesis that U is open is not needed in this argument; it is kept to match the caller.) ∎
key_steps: ψ = φ•g is Lipschitz, compactly supported in U, ‖ψ‖ ≤ 1, so ofReal(∫_U u div ψ) ≤ |Du|(U) (Submission.bv_ext_ofReal_integral_le_bvVariationOn), and ∫_U u div ψ = ∫ u div ψ.
A.e. product rule (Rademacher + Submission.bv_ext_euclideanDivergence_smul): φ u div g = u div ψ − u Dφ[g] ≤ u div ψ + |u|‖Dφ‖.
Integrate and convert to [0,∞] with ofReal_add_le.
